biggest_catch: You only earn the $25 when your friend actually becomes a member AND opens both a Share Savings and a Kasasa Checking account. A friend who joins but never opens the checking account earns you nothing.
catches: Referred friend must become a new member and open BOTH a Share Savings account and a Kasasa (Free-Reward) Checking account.
$25 bonus paid within two weeks of account opening.
The referral bonus to the current (referring) member may be subject to tax reporting for amounts in excess of $600.
No stated limit on the number of referrals. evergreenDIRECT Credit Union may cancel the promotion at any time without prior notice.

c1.evidence: Flyer PDF served from evergreendirect.org, the credit union's official domain.

c2.evidence: Flyer states 'SHARE US - YOU BOTH GET $25!' when friends or family become a member — concrete per-referral payout to the referrer.

c3.evidence: Friend requirements stated: new member must establish a Share Savings and a Kasasa Checking account.

c4.evidence: No fee charged to the referrer; the coupon is completed and shared free.

eligibility: Current evergreenDIRECT Credit Union member who completes and shares the referral coupon. Referred friend must be a new member who opens Share Savings + Kasasa Checking.
notes: Verified 2026-09-23 from the credit union's official membership-referral flyer. Distinct from the credit union's separate $50 loan-referral program (R4287). No stated referral cap ('There is no limit to how many referrals you can earn!').
numeric_basis: payout from official flyer ($25 to referrer per qualifying membership referral); time: complete coupon + share with friend est. 5-15 min active
payout_value_note: $25 to the referring (current) member per friend/family member who becomes a member and opens Share Savings + Kasasa Checking; no stated referral cap.

s1.note: Membership referral is a distinct mechanism from the $50 loan referral (R4287).

s2.note: No existing evergreenDIRECT route in catalog or evidence files.

s3.note: Flyer live on official domain as of 2026-09-23; no expiry stated.

s4.note: Framed as conditional: payout only when the friend becomes a member and opens both accounts.

s5.note: Tax reporting for amounts over $600 disclosed on the flyer.

s6.note: Explicitly no limit on number of referrals.

s7.note: Paper coupon / in-branch; no app required.

steps: Complete the referral coupon with your current-member name and cell phone.
Share the coupon with friends, family, and coworkers.
Your friend becomes a new evergreenDIRECT member and opens a Share Savings account and a Kasasa Checking account.
Your $25 bonus is paid within two weeks of account opening.
timing: Bonus $25 paid within two weeks of account opening.
